company.name: OpenUnit
company.shortDescription: OpenUnit specializes in the fields of reservation system, merchant solutions, and management software.
company.description:
OpenUnit is an internet company that features a set of tools that gives storage operators the things they need such as online presence, reservation system, merchant solutions, and management software. It specializes in the fields of information technology, internet, and software platforms.

It was founded in 2019 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based software platform for managing self-storage facilities, including customer data, unit inventory, pricing, and operational analytics.
productsAndServices.name: OpenUnit Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: An integrated payment processing system for self-storage facilities supporting online and in-person payments with fixed transparent rates.
productsAndServices.name: OpenUnit Payments

productsAndServices.description: Point-of-sale software and pre-certified card readers for processing in-person payments at self-storage facilities.
productsAndServices.name: OpenUnit Point-of-Sale (POS) Software and Hardware

productsAndServices.description: Tools for creating and managing self-storage facility websites, online reservations, SEO, and digital marketing campaigns.
productsAndServices.name: OpenUnit Marketing and Website Management

productsAndServices.description: A CRM system tailored for self-storage facilities to manage leads, customer profiles, messaging, and lease agreements.
productsAndServices.name: OpenUnit Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

productsAndServices.description: A communication and task management tool for self-storage facility teams, including real-time chat, to-do lists, and role-based permissions.
productsAndServices.name: OpenUnit Team Chat and Employee Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,000,000, or 86.96% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,660,148 to $7,018,910, a 2.64x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
